caption: Low-effort oven veggie pasta 🤍 A family dinner that’s toddler-friendly and doesn’t require much thinking. Why we love this meal: • Everything bakes in one dish • Packed with veggies • Creamy without heavy sauces • Easy to adapt for toddlers • Perfect for busy weeknights Ingredients: • 1 pack pasta, cooked • ½ small onion, finely diced • 2 garlic cloves, minced • ½ cup shredded zucchini or broccoli • Handful baby spinach • ½ cup cottage cheese • 1 cup tomato sauce • ⅓ cup pasta water • Salt & pepper • Onion powder • Garlic powder • Paprika • Oregano • Italian seasoning • Mozzarella & cheddar cheese (for topping) Save this for later & follow for easy family meals that actually work ✨ #easydinnerideas #familydinner #toddlermeals #toddlerrecipes #babyledweaning
